[RARC.3.1] Each tier runs its own engine, with its own working memory
and its own settings ([LDIA.1.3]); a rule file compiles against the settings
of the tier it targets. The language-side tier contract is [LTIE.8.1]'s, and the
topology is the integrator's ([LTIE.2]). This section specifies what the
runtime provides so that contract holds for any topology an integrator picks.
